note: Short field checks for each species. Drawn diagrams in public/illustrations are simplified and not to scale.

fagus_sylvatica: Oval leaf with a smooth or slightly wavy edge; fine hairs along the edge when young
Smooth grey bark, even on old trees
abies_alba: Single flat needles with a notched tip and two white lines underneath
Upright cones stand on the top of the branches
castanea_sativa: Long, narrow leaves with sharp, evenly spaced teeth
Spiny green burrs hold the chestnuts
quercus_ilex: Leathery leaves, dark and glossy above, grey-felted below
Young trees have spiny leaf edges; older leaves are often smooth
robinia_pseudacacia: 9 to 19 small leaflets on one stem
Spines at the base of young shoots
pinus_nigra: Needles in pairs, dark green, stiff, 8 to 20 cm
Grey, cracked bark on older trunks
ilex_aquifolium: Very glossy, evergreen leaves with spiny edges on lower branches
quercus_cerris: Acorn cup covered with long, hair-like scales
quercus_pubescens: Lobed leaves, downy underneath, especially when young
alnus_incana: Pointed oval leaf with double-toothed edges
Catkins and small cones; grey bark on young trees
pinus_pinaster: Long, stiff needles in pairs, 12 to 25 cm, light green
Reddish, plated bark on old trunks
quercus_petraea: Deeply lobed leaves with a very short stalk
Acorns sit directly on the twig
populus_nigra: Triangular leaf with a very pointed tip
pinus_laricio: Needles in pairs, dark green, 8 to 20 cm
Tall, straight trunk with grey-brown bark
juglans_regia: 5 to 9 large leaflets with smooth edges
alnus_glutinosa: Rounded leaf with a notched tip
Sticky young shoots and small woody cones
pinus_strobus: Needles in bundles of five, soft and blue-green, 6 to 10 cm
sambucus_nigra: Shoots have pale, white pith inside
acer_pseudoplatanus: Five pointed lobes with coarse teeth
alnus_cordata: Pointed, glossy leaf with a shiny top
quercus_robur: Lobed leaves on a short stalk
carpinus_betulus: Oval leaf with double teeth and strongly ribbed veins
Bark smooth and grey, like muscle
populus_tremula: Rounded leaf on a flattened stalk, trembles in the wind
pseudotsuga_menziesii: Flat, soft needles with a pointed or rounded tip, smelling of citrus when crushed
Hanging cones with three-pointed bracts sticking out between the scales
rhamnus_alaternus: Small, leathery, glossy oval leaves with a smooth edge
hedera_helix: Glossy leaves with three to five lobes
